## Free SEO tools

- [Website SEO audit](https://agmanrajpurohit.com/seo-audit): crawls up to 100 pages of a website and reports technical, on-page, content, speed, mobile, image, linking and structured data issues.
- [Keyword density checker](https://agmanrajpurohit.com/free-seo-tools/keyword-density-checker): counts words and 2–3 word phrases in pasted text or a live URL, and checks a focus keyword.
- [Meta tag generator](https://agmanrajpurohit.com/free-seo-tools/meta-tag-generator): builds title, description, robots, canonical, Open Graph and X tags with live previews.
- [SERP snippet preview](https://agmanrajpurohit.com/free-seo-tools/serp-snippet-preview): pixel-accurate preview of a Google result on desktop and mobile.
- [Schema markup generator](https://agmanrajpurohit.com/free-seo-tools/schema-markup-generator): JSON-LD for Article, LocalBusiness, Organization, Person, Product, FAQ, Breadcrumb, Event and WebSite.
- [Robots.txt generator](https://agmanrajpurohit.com/free-seo-tools/robots-txt-generator): robots.txt with presets and separate controls for AI training and AI search crawlers.
- [XML sitemap generator](https://agmanrajpurohit.com/free-seo-tools/sitemap-generator): crawls a site (up to 250 pages, respecting robots.txt) or takes a URL list, and skips noindex, redirected and broken pages.
- [Contact](https://agmanrajpurohit.com/contact): email, phone and WhatsApp for Dubai and Ahmedabad, plus a contact form.
